status: PILOT - thresholds chosen on the 10-case COVID pilot (2026-11-15); not prospectively defined, not clinically validated.

opacity_proxy.name: dense-lung proxy (HU band inside predicted lungs)
opacity_proxy.note: Not a lesion segmentation: counts lung voxels denser than aerated lung after removing vessels, airways and the pleural rim. Dependent atelectasis and partial volume also count. To be replaced by a trained opacity segmenter (pipeline step 1).

pilot_validation.volume: under-estimates large faint disease (coronacases_001: 139 vs 429 mL; 003: 482 vs 1037 mL)
pilot_validation.caveat: The demo case is part of this pilot set, so these figures are not an independent test.

reliability.lung_volumes: high - TotalSegmentator lungs vs expert lung masks, Dice 0.975-0.985 on the 10 pilot cases (Phase 2)
reliability.lobe_volumes: moderate - TotalSegmentator lobes, no lobe reference in this dataset
reliability.opacity_proxy_amount: low-moderate - proxy, Dice 0.43-0.73 vs expert masks on the pilot; under-estimates faint disease
reliability.opacity_proxy_distribution: moderate - zone 8/10 and peripheral/central 8/10 vs expert masks on the pilot (rules v2, provisional definitions)
reliability.opacity_proxy_presence: low - no normal scans available to calibrate; dependent atelectasis also counts
reliability.emphysema_laa950: moderate - standard measure, not validated here; depends on slice thickness and reconstruction kernel
reliability.airway_tree: low - unvalidated, no airway reference; counts depend on segmentation and settings; fewer branches do not mean airway loss

crosscheck.note: If one side holds >= 75% of the dense-lung proxy, a reader answer of 'bilateral' is flagged as missing a strong one-sided predominance.
